Coram : S.B. SINHA*, MARKANDEY KATJU
Adverse possession-Burden to prove-Suit claiming title by sale deed-Defendants claiming adverse possession-Dismissal of suit-First Appellate Court holding in favour of plaintiff-High Court formulated question as to whether the lower appellate court was correct putting the burden to prove the of defendants-On appeal, held: Once the plaintiff proves his title, the burden shifts to the defendant to establish perfection of his title by adverse possession-High Court formulated a wrong question-Hence matter remitted to High Court­ Limitation Act, 1908-Articles 142 and 144-Lirnitation
Decision Date : 11-01-2007 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6195/2000 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
